dct_description_sm: Mercury is a toxic pollutant which can pose risks to human health. In June 2010, concerns in the Dene/Metis community of Tulita, NWT were raised when a public health advisory on an increase in mercury in four lakes was released, recommending that people limit the amount of Lake Trout consumed from these lakes, due to possible health risks. Since Lake Trout is consumed year round, therefore raising the possibility of mercury exposure, there is a need to assess the risk and benefits of fish consumption. Hair samples were provided for mercury analysis.
